category_title: Low-achieving students with disruptive behaviors and high absenteeism
minimal_context: The student is asked to classify 22 words written on the whiteboard and name each category during a classroom session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, look at the 22 words on the whiteboard. I need you to stay in your assigned seats, classify these words into groups, and write down a name for each class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from desk) I don't want to sit here. I'm going over to that group to talk to my friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down and focus on the words on the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why can't we pick our own groups or play a game instead? We should be able to suggest activities we actually want to do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are not playing a game today. You need to stay quiet and do the classification task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Argues loudly) I'm not just going to sit here and be quiet! This is stupid, I'm leaving. (Walks out of the classroom door)
